title: Add Search Input
content: Create search input component with accessories. Container: relative flex items-center. Search icon: absolute left-3 w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none. Input: w-full pl-10 pr-10 h-10 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500. Placeholder: "Search..." in gray. Clear button: absolute right-3, X icon, visible only when input has value. Keyboard: Enter to submit, Escape to clear. Loading state: spinner replacing clear button while searching. Debounced onChange for performance.

variants.simple: Create a search input with icon and clear button.
variants.detailed: Create search input component with accessories. Container: relative flex items-center. Search icon: absolute left-3 w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none. Input: w-full pl-10 pr-10 h-10 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500. Placeholder: "Search..." in gray. variants.advanced: Create feature-rich search input with autocomplete support. Container: relative w-full max-w-md. Input wrapper: relative flex items-center. Search icon: absolute left-3 w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none z-10. Input: w-full h-10 pl-10 pr-10 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition-shadow. Right accessories: absolute right-2 flex items-center gap-1. Clear button: p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100, X icon w-4 h-4, opacity-0 when empty, tabIndex={-1} to skip in tab order. Loading spinner: w-4 h-4 animate-spin when loading. Keyboard shortcut hint: hidden sm:flex text-xs text-gray-400 border rounded px-1.5 "⌘K". Dropdown suggestions: absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-white border rounded-lg shadow-lg z-50 max-h-[300px] overflow-auto. Suggestion item: px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer, highlight matching text with font-medium or bg-yellow-100. Keyboard navigation: arrow up/down through suggestions, Enter to select, Escape to close. Recent searches: section showing last 5 searches with clock icon. Debouncing: 300ms delay before triggering search API. Accessibility: role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant for suggestions. Props: value, onChange, onSearch, placeholder, suggestions, loading, showRecent, debounceMs, shortcutKey.
